messages:
morgan: Heads-up — new tenant 'orion' onboarding in ap-southeast-5. They need p5, p4d, and g5 capacity to start (prod + canary). Can someone kick off the AWS quota/ENI requests and confirm VPC subnet sizing?

ali: Got it. What numbers are we targeting for the initial reserve? also need the AWS account IDs and intended go-live date.

morgan: Initial ask: p5.24xlarge (p5) x4, p4d.24xlarge x2, g5.48xlarge x8. ENI quota per account bump to 1500, and EC2 instance quota for Accelerators to match. Account: 123456789012. Go-live window: 2026-04-05 (soft), heavy traffic expected w/in 2 weeks after.

ali: Thanks. I'll open a support case now. Is there a preferred fallback region if capacity is constrained?

morgan: Prefer ap-southeast-5 but can fall back to ap-southeast-2 for prod if necessary. Canary needs to stay in same region for data locality though.

infra-bot: Support case created with AWS: case #case-2026-AP5-98765. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/case-2026-AP5-98765 (ETA from AWS: 3-5 business days) :white_check_mark:

jess: Cost note — if they really run those shapes at scale we'll be ~2.2x on hourly vs g5-only baseline. Recommend we propose a start with half the p5/p4d, validate perf, then scale. Also ask sales to confirm budget/commit.

samir: Subnet sizing: ensure /22 or larger for worker subnets if they plan >200 instances per AZ because of ENI attachment limits. Also check hostLimits on ENIs in the AMI -> some images reserve ENIs for provisioning.

morgan: Good call. For onboarding we'll request 50 instance sockets per AZ initially (so that maps to the counts above). I'll add that to the case. Terraform snippet for the account alias + requested quota note we put in the ticket:

```hcl
resource "aws_iam_account_alias" "orion" {
  account_alias = "orion-prod"
}
# quota request: p5:4 p4d:2 g5:8 eni:1500
```

ali: Updated case with the exact numbers and subnet recommendation. AWS responded with "Case received" and asked for business justification and expected monthly vCPU/accelerator hours — provided that. AWS asked if we can tolerate staged increase vs all-at-once.

morgan: We can stage. Request phase 1: p4d x2 + g5 x4 + ENI 800. Phase 2 after smoke tests will request remaining.

jess: +1 on staged. Also flag finance: possible spike in monthly committed costs. tagging @finance in the case would help speed approvals.

ali: AWS replied: initial quota adjustments approved for ENI->800 and g5->4 within 24 hours, p4d/p5 pending additional capacity review (they put a hold for accelerator inventory check). Assigned rep asked for a follow-up on 2026-03-30.

morgan: Thanks. I'll schedule a short on-call window for rollout and add a canary job to the cluster to validate perf once the g5s land. Can someone add a quick runbook?

samir: I'll draft a runbook: verify node provisioning, confirm nv_peer_mem on drivers, run perf microbench (latency and token/s), validate KV cache persistence, then scale. Will post PR in infra-runbooks.

jess: Also list fallback plan: autopromote to ap-southeast-2 model pool + rate-limit heavier routes. Keep customers notified.

ali: I'll update the case with the staged plan and ask AWS for an estimated completion for p4d/p5 once they finish inventory check. Case now: case-2026-AP5-98765.

morgan: Great. Closing ask here for now. If AWS approves accelerators, we will create capacity reservation tickets for Dedicated pool and loop in sales + finance. :thumbsup:
